sentences.en: Air is a mixture of gases that we cannot see.
sentences.zh: 空气是由我们看不见的各种气体混合而成。

sentences.en: I usually gas up the car at this service station.
sentences.zh: 我通常在这个加油站给车加油。

sentences.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
sentences.zh: 爆炸可能是由天然气泄漏引起的。

senses.zh: 放出气体；加油；空谈 GASabbr.
